name: Cape Town
housing: Cape Town renters live in apartments along the Atlantic seaboard and City Bowl, older cottages, and houses in the southern and northern suburbs.

tenantHelp.name: Western Cape Rental Housing Tribunal
tenantHelp.what: free dispute service for tenants and landlords

climate: Winters are wet and windy, so check for damp, leaks and mould; in summer the south-easter wind tests windows and doors.
fact: Under the Rental Housing Act, landlord and tenant should inspect the home together before move-in and again at the end.
